text: まっ　おれさまは　もう　ポケモンのタマゴも　もらったし　この　しまに　ようは　ねーぜ！

structure.jp: まっ　おれさまは　もう　ポケモンのタマゴも　もらったし
structure.en: well, I've already gotten a Pokémon Egg too, so

structure.jp: この　しまに　ようは　ねーぜ！
structure.en: I've got no business on this island!

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a phrase gives a reason, with a feeling of 'and besides'. もらったし = 'I already got one, so'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねー is the rough, slurred way of saying ない, 'there is none'. ようは　ねーぜ = 'I've got no business here'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, boyish speech that pushes the statement at the listener. ねーぜ = 'there's none, I tell you'.
